guidance.body: Flatten project configuration into schema v3 and separate the Corpus baseline.
guidance.guidance:
Update direct JSON readers from `dev.profiles.<name>.targets` to
`dev.targets`. Remove dependencies on `dev.profile`, `${dev.profile}`, and
`SVC_DEV_PROFILE`; schema v3 has no runtime profile dimension. During
transition, make project readers accept both v2 and v3 before applying the
SVC-owned file migration.

The automatic transform renames `svc_version` to `corpus_version`, flattens
exactly one selected profile, preserves `run`, and migrates a present local
overlay. It blocks multiple profiles rather than discarding data. The new
optional target-local `stop` declaration is never inferred.

After apply, run the project's real configuration readers and dev/runtime
checks. SVC proves only the exact config-file transformation; applying the
plan is the caller's assertion that project-owned consumers were updated.
